capabilities.name: Raw episodes
capabilities.definition: The system preserves source episodes or turns as retrievable memory.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe or demonstrate preservation of source episodes.

capabilities.name: Structured facts
capabilities.definition: The system represents memory as structured facts or attributes rather than only raw text.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe structured fact representation.

capabilities.name: Knowledge graph
capabilities.definition: The system represents entities and relations as a graph that can be queried.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe graph construction or graph retrieval.

capabilities.name: Memory extraction
capabilities.definition: The system extracts persistent memory from conversations or agent traces.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe extraction from an input trace.

capabilities.name: Memory consolidation
capabilities.definition: The system merges, compresses, or organizes multiple memories during maintenance.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe a consolidation or maintenance operation.

capabilities.name: Agent authored memory
capabilities.definition: The agent can deliberately decide what to write or update in persistent memory.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must show agent controlled memory writes.

capabilities.name: Dense retrieval
capabilities.definition: The system retrieves memory using vector similarity.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary implementation or documentation must identify vector retrieval.

capabilities.name: Lexical retrieval
capabilities.definition: The system retrieves memory using lexical or full text search.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary implementation or documentation must identify lexical retrieval.

capabilities.name: Graph traversal
capabilities.definition: The system expands retrieval through graph relations or traversals.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe relation traversal during retrieval.

capabilities.name: Query time context construction
capabilities.definition: The system constructs or expands the memory context at query time using the retrieved evidence.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe query time context expansion or construction.

capabilities.name: Supersession
capabilities.definition: The system represents that a newer memory replaces an older memory.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe supersession or replacement behavior.

capabilities.name: Contradiction handling
capabilities.definition: The system detects or represents conflicting memories.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe conflict detection or representation.

capabilities.name: Rollback
capabilities.definition: The system can restore or select an earlier memory state.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe restoration of a previous memory state.

capabilities.name: Valid time
capabilities.definition: The system records when a fact was true in the world.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must identify fact validity intervals or equivalent semantics.

capabilities.name: Ingestion time
capabilities.definition: The system records when it learned or ingested a fact.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must identify ingestion or observation timestamps.

capabilities.name: Point in time retrieval
capabilities.definition: The system can answer what was known or valid at a requested historical time.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must demonstrate or document historical time queries.

capabilities.name: Source attribution
capabilities.definition: A returned memory can identify the source evidence supporting it.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must show source or document attribution in the returned memory.

capabilities.name: Transformation lineage
capabilities.definition: Derived memories link back through transformations to their source evidence.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe links from derived memory to source material.

capabilities.name: Evidence receipts
capabilities.definition: The system returns a machine readable record of evidence used for a memory result.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must show a structured evidence result or receipt.

capabilities.name: Abstention
capabilities.definition: The system can return an explicit refusal when memory support is insufficient.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe or demonstrate an explicit abstention result.

capabilities.name: Entailment checking
capabilities.definition: The system checks whether retrieved evidence actually supports the requested claim.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe an entailment or support check.

capabilities.name: Confidence calibration
capabilities.definition: The system calibrates a trust or confidence decision against labeled examples.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe calibration data or a calibrated decision boundary.

capabilities.name: User consent
capabilities.definition: The system makes persistent memory subject to an explicit user consent or control decision.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe user control over persistence.

capabilities.name: Tenant scope
capabilities.definition: The system enforces tenant boundaries on memory storage and retrieval.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary implementation or documentation must describe tenant isolation.

capabilities.name: Multi agent handoff
capabilities.definition: Memory can be intentionally shared or handed from one agent to another with scope semantics.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe cross agent memory sharing or handoff.

capabilities.name: Source deletion
capabilities.definition: A source memory can be deleted from the system.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe source deletion.

capabilities.name: Derived deletion propagation
capabilities.definition: Deleting a source removes or invalidates derived memories, graph edges, embeddings, and caches that depend on it.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe deletion across derived artifacts.

capabilities.name: Selective forgetting
capabilities.definition: The system can forget selected memories without clearing unrelated memory.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must demonstrate selective deletion or forgetting.

capabilities.name: Outcome storage
capabilities.definition: The system stores observed results of agent actions as reusable memory.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe action outcome persistence.

capabilities.name: Outcome linked revision
capabilities.definition: An observed action result updates the memory claim that influenced that action.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe the link between action outcome and later memory behavior.

capabilities.name: Policy revision
capabilities.definition: Remembered outcomes modify future agent behavior or policy selection.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must demonstrate outcome driven behavior change.

capabilities.name: Prompt injection resistance
capabilities.definition: The system limits memory content from changing agent instructions or tool authority through injection.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe an injection defense or evaluation.

capabilities.name: Memory poisoning resistance
capabilities.definition: The system detects or limits malicious or misleading persistent memories.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe poisoning detection or prevention.

capabilities.name: Egress control
capabilities.definition: The system controls which memory fields can leave the memory boundary for a model or tool.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must describe purpose or policy aware memory egress.

capabilities.name: Temporal evaluation
capabilities.definition: The system is evaluated on changing facts and historical validity.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must identify a temporal memory evaluation.

capabilities.name: Conflict evaluation
capabilities.definition: The system is evaluated on contradictory memories or conflicting claims.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must identify a conflict resolution evaluation.

capabilities.name: Action impact evaluation
capabilities.definition: The system is evaluated by whether memory improves downstream agent actions or outcomes.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must identify an outcome or action based memory evaluation.

capabilities.name: Continual learning evaluation
capabilities.definition: The system is evaluated over an ordered sequence of tasks or episodes where memory must support transfer and forgetting.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must identify an online, continual, transfer, or forgetting evaluation.

capabilities.name: Memory security evaluation
capabilities.definition: The system or benchmark is evaluated on persistent memory poisoning, prompt injection, downstream consequences, or selective repair.
capabilities.minimum_evidence: Primary evidence must identify a memory security attack, lifecycle evaluation, or repair benchmark.
